text: This might be a silly question so forgive me. I've got my grandson tonight, he's 13 months. He's got a temperature of 38. His eczema has flared up, he's got dry patches on his arms that he keeps scratching. And one of his eyes is pink and a bit sticky, gunky in the corner. He flopped on the sofa earlier and I had a bit of a fright but honestly it's been a very long day, we were out at the park and then his cousins were round, he was just worn out. I gave him a nudge and he woke straight up and started babbling at me like normal. So I think he's alright, I just don't know if the eye needs anything or if it can wait for his own doctor
